rule_outs: Dwelling 6 m from the best section
summary: Steep street kerb beside the rail corridor, with homes 10-25 m away.
reasons: Rail corridor opposite, no dwellings that side
Detached homes 10-25 m on own side

drivers.seclusion: Rail line and grass verge opposite; houses on the kerb's own side sit about 12 m and 24 m from the section, with others at 5-6 m just beyond either end.
drivers.access_and_room: Cars are parked on this kerb further back; the road looks narrow, so room to pull fully off is tight.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street with a corner junction; train noise from the adjacent line.
drivers.convention: Some parked cars along the kerb, no sign of overnight stays.

flags: Steep: about 8% grade here, 16% mean over the whole stretch
Rail noise from the adjacent corridor
Dwellings at 5-6 m just either side of the section
sun_shade: Open to the north and east over the rail verge; trees shade the lower stretch near 50 m.

best_section.where: South kerb of Cunningham Street, midway between the two bends, opposite the rail verge
